column1: # The built-in functions of Lucee 7.1: its core function library (core-base.fld), its ESAPI, image and
# Hibernate extensions, and the functions it writes in CFML. Each is its name, its return type, the member
# functions it is as @receiver.name, with ! when it returns its receiver, or - for none, then each argument as
# name:type. A name is spelled as cfdocs.org spells it. One cfdocs lacks starts in lower case, an acronym too.
